scope: Native offline Unity Play Mode. Admin navigation, stop/resume, lighting, existing timer, inventory, teammate rescue, topic lock, capture release and reset. No physical-device or multi-client test.
checks: PASS One Admin launcher opens the themed lab
PASS Six named sections replace the mixed control list
PASS Legacy tools and floating keyboard respawn prompt stay hidden
PASS Each section clips correctly and has a visible drag scrollbar
PASS Admin panel stays within the landscape safe area
PASS Stop Monsters places the active guardian asleep and sets the existing shared test checkpoint
PASS Stop persists against manual hunting and automatic night awakening
PASS Monster stop survives the existing world-state checkpoint serialization
PASS Changing lighting adds no mistakes, topic progress or surprise night entrance
PASS Add 5 minutes changes the original match deadline exactly once
PASS Remove 5 minutes restores the same original deadline
PASS Automatic time returns to topic-driven progression
PASS Give All uses the selected player's actual six-item inventory
PASS Damage button deducts exactly one heart
PASS Granted medkit works through the real use command
PASS Spawn selects a distinct practice teammate without stealing local player ownership
PASS Down At Nest affects only the selected teammate; the tester remains free
PASS Admin rescue releases the selected downed body and restores one heart
PASS Removing the selected practice actor safely falls back to yourself
PASS Go & Start Topic uses the selected topic's real Book flow
PASS Another topic's start button is disabled while T8 is unfinished
PASS Complete Active Topic clears the actual running topic without mistakes
PASS First reset tap requests confirmation without deleting progress
PASS Second reset tap clears the chosen topic and invalidates stale work
PASS Stop Monsters handles both primary and secondary guardians at night
PASS Night progression does not restart or move stopped monsters
PASS Resume wakes both active guardians using their existing encounter controls
PASS Enter Barrier uses the actual captured-player challenge and movement lock
PASS Stop safely releases an active capture without leaving a movement lock
PASS Return To Spawn uses the existing player spawn and camera reset
PASS Open Portal completes all ten topics for the existing escape flow
PASS Full match reset also requires a second deliberate tap
PASS Full reset clears fixture progress, monster stop override and damage
PASS Admin never pauses global game time
